ns2:course.label: Molecular Marker Data Analyses
ns2:course.description: Statistical analyses and interpretation of molecular marker data including development of genetic maps, cluster analyses, quantitative trait loci analyses, and plant breeding applications of molecular marker data. Summer session I in alternate years. Prerequisite: CPSC 440 or equivalent, and CPSC 453 or equivalent. An advanced statistics course (e.g. ANSC 445 or equivalent) and familiarity with SAS recommended.
